integrations.evidence: Ten named buying channels including Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, Roku and Spotify plus an API (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Scene generation, AI Studio media creation and predictive budget allocation are production features (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise platform (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2013 with a decade of enterprise creative operations (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Snowplow is behavioral data infrastructure you can own: the pipeline is Apache-2.0 and the cloud is a quote. If an event schema matters more than a dashboard, this is the right layer.

pricing_transparency.evidence: The open-source pipeline is free to self-host and clearly stated; BDP Cloud is quoted by sales (verified Sep 2026, tools.json).

feature_depth.evidence: Event pipelines to six warehouse/lake formats plus real-time profiles with propensity and intent signals (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Kafka, Kinesis and Pub/Sub documented (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Signals propensity predictions, intent detection and agentic context for AI agents make it model-ready plumbing (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Apache-2.0 self-hosted pipeline with 7.0k GitHub stars and warehouse-first design (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2012 with a commercial cloud arm and long enterprise deployments (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Sprout Social is the premium social suite: per-seat pricing at $249 and up buys polished engagement and listening. The 30-day trial is long enough to know if the polish matters to your team.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Standard $249/seat/mo, Professional $399/seat/mo published with a 30-day trial; Advanced is custom (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Publishing, engagement, listening and sentiment analytics cover enterprise social operations (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Salesforce, Zendesk, Shopify, Canva, GA, Drive, Dropbox and Yelp documented plus an API (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI reply assist, sentiment analysis and listening queries put the models where support volume is (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS with API access (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2010 and publicly listed with enterprise social deployments behind it (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Strapi is the headless CMS with the biggest community in the category and an AI layer that stays optional. Self-hosted free with cloud tiers from free to $499/mo is the right shape for a content platform.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Self-hosted free (MIT), Cloud Developer free, Pro $99/mo, Team $499/mo, Enterprise custom, all published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: API-first content management with media handling and workflows covers the headless CMS job fully (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: Next.js, Nuxt, Gatsby, Zapier, Slack, Stripe, Algolia and Cloudinary documented plus its core APIs (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI content generation, workflows, media management and translation are present but optional add-ons (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: MIT-licensed core with 73.1k GitHub stars and free self-hosting with no feature paywall (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2015 with a commercial cloud arm and the category's largest contributor base (tools.json).

tools.verdict: SuiteCRM is the safe long-liver of open-source CRM: sales, marketing and support automation on one AGPL codebase. The AI era has not really arrived on it yet.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free self-hosted open source with paid cloud hosting available; the hosting prices are not itemized in the catalog (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Sales, marketing and support automation across one codebase covers the full CRM triangle, the reason it persists (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: No named integrations in the catalog; APIs and community modules carry the extension story (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: No AI features are documented in the catalog as of 2026-09-28 (tools.json ai_features is empty).

openness.evidence: AGPL-3.0 self-hosted with 5.7k GitHub stars and the whole suite free (tools.json, github.com/salesagility/SuiteCRM).

operational_maturity.evidence: A SugarCRM fork with years of production deployments and a stable release cadence (tools.json deep_dive).

tools.verdict: Tealium is the enterprise data layer: tag management and a CDP with governance built in. Annual contracts and custom pricing fit the regulated part of the market it was built for.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Enterprise custom pricing on annual contracts with no public tier table (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Tag management, CDP modules, identity resolution and data governance cover the enterprise data layer (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Salesforce, Adobe, Snowflake, Braze, GA, Meta Ads, Amplitude and Slack documented plus an API (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI segmentation, enrichment and identity resolution serve the data layer rather than the front line (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise platform (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2008 with long regulated-industry deployments (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Trakkr's interesting angle is perception: how models describe your brand, not only whether they cite it. Per-brand pricing suits agencies running multiple workspaces.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Growth is $100/mo per brand (50 prompts, 8 models, 3 seats) or $1,000/yr annual, Scale $500/mo for 10 brands, both published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Citations, perception analysis, competitor rankings and action recommendations cover measurement and prioritization, stopping short of content execution (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Zapier, Slack, Sheets, Notion, HubSpot and WordPress are documented, which is a practical six for agency workflows (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Perception analysis of how AI describes your brand is the standout; the rest is model-output measurement (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS; no self-hosting or open export terms in the catalog (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Priced for brands and agencies with per-brand workspaces, but thin public company history (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Tray.io sits between Pipedream and Workato: a builder's iPaaS with an agent gateway that takes MCP seriously. Task-metered pricing is published in shape but not in numbers.

pricing_transparency.evidence: No published prices: three tiers metered in Tasks with workspaces and log retention as the levers (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Merlin Agent Builder, an Agent Gateway for MCP, AI Palette and VectorTables make a current platform rather than a connector host (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Salesforce, Slack, HubSpot, Snowflake, Zendesk, BigQuery, Sheets, NetSuite plus OpenAI and Claude connections documented (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Merlin Agent Builder and the MCP Agent Gateway put agents at the center of the platform, not the edge (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise SaaS; portability is contractual (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2012 with enterprise tiers and mature support posture (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Triple Whale is DTC attribution with an opinion: profit tracking and creative analytics over Shopify data. GMV-scaled pricing fits the storefront it was built for and few others.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Conversion $59/mo, Retention $179/mo, Foundation $219/mo published with GMV scaling (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Attribution, LTV, creative analytics and profit tracking cover the DTC measurement loop (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Shopify, Meta, Google and TikTok Ads, Klaviyo, Slack, Zapier and Stripe documented (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI attribution modeling and creative analytics fit the storefront use case well (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS tied to your ad and store connections (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2021 with priced tiers and a DTC-focused customer base (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Twenty is the strongest open-source bet for teams that want Salesforce-shaped CRM data on their own server and are willing to run a young codebase. The AI workspace features are real, but the project is three years old and the premium-feature split is still settling.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Self-hosted core is free under AGPLv3 with Pro features included; Cloud Pro is $9/user/mo billed yearly and Organization $19/user/mo, with premium features gated behind an Enterprise key (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Objects, workflows, email sync and dashboards cover the CRM baseline; workflow AI agents and AI-built dashboards push past it, though marketing campaign tooling is absent (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: Gmail, Outlook and CalDAV sync plus signed webhooks and REST/GraphQL APIs ship in core; there is no connector marketplace to extend beyond that (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: An AI chatbot over workspace data, agents inside workflows and a native MCP server on cloud workplaces put it ahead of most CRM peers (tools.json ai_features; MCP is a site claim).

openness.evidence: AGPLv3 with all Pro features in the free self-hosted tier and 56.5k GitHub stars; only premium add-ons need a paid key (tools.json, github.com/twentyhq/twenty).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2023 with 56.5k stars and fast shipping, but no decade of operational history and the enterprise support tier is still forming (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Warmbly packages cold email honestly as open source: Apache 2.0, self-hosted, with warmup and reply classification built in. At 316 stars and a 2026 founding date, you are the early adopter and the operator.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free to self-host under Apache 2.0; cloud free plan with 10 mailboxes, Starter $29/mo (150 sends/day), Grow $89/mo (3,000 sends/day) published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Warmup, campaigns, a unified inbox and CRM make a complete cold-email loop for its size (tools.json deep_dive).

integrations.evidence: HubSpot, Slack, Zapier, Gmail, Microsoft 365 and SMTP plus REST API and HMAC webhooks documented (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Agent steps that branch on classified reply intent with automatic reply classification (positive, OOO, unsubscribe, bounce) are genuinely agentic (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Apache-2.0 self-hosted with no cloud dependency and 316 GitHub stars (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2026 with 316 stars; the operating history is measured in months (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Workato is the governance-first iPaaS: agent roles, audit machinery and enterprise editions. The pricing model is deliberately a conversation, and so is everything else.

pricing_transparency.evidence: No published prices: a platform edition fee plus a usage fee in one billing unit across four editions (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: AIRO multi-agent system, Agent Studio, role-based Genies and an Acumen data scientist agent sit on mature integration plumbing (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Salesforce, Slack, SAP, Workday, NetSuite, ServiceNow, Snowflake and HubSpot named in the catalog, with hundreds more behind the sales wall (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: A multi-agent system with role-based agents and agent studio is one of the deepest AI governance plays in the category (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed enterprise SaaS with contractual portability only (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2013 with enterprise editions and the support machinery regulated buyers require (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Writer is the enterprise content platform with its own Palmyra models and brand governance that legal teams can read. With no public prices, it competes on trust and procurement comfort.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Quote-based: writer.com serves no public price table to anonymous visitors (verified Sep 2026, tools.json).

feature_depth.evidence: Brand governance, Knowledge Graph grounding and 100+ prebuilt agents in the Agent Library make it a platform (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Contentful, Figma, Snowflake and Databricks documented plus an API (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: Its own Palmyra model family plus Knowledge Graph grounding and agent tooling go past wrapper territory (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed platform, though the Palmyra models and API keep some portability (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2020 with enterprise governance features and named compliance posture (tools.json).

tools.verdict: Zapier remains the safest automation buy: the widest app catalog and the least surprising product. You pay per task for that safety, which scales into real money at volume.

pricing_transparency.evidence: Free (100 tasks/mo, 2-step Zaps), Professional $19.99/mo and Team $69/mo billed annually, all published (tools.json, verified 2026-09-28).

feature_depth.evidence: Multi-step Zaps, logic, tables and the AI workflow builder cover nearly every automation shape a marketing team needs (tools.json ai_features).

integrations.evidence: 9,000+ connected apps including Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, Zendesk and NetSuite; nothing else in the category is close on breadth (tools.json).

ai_capability.evidence: AI workflow builder, data formatting, content generation, chatbot builder and AI agents are all shipping product (tools.json ai_features).

openness.evidence: Closed SaaS with a strong API; your workflows are portable only as re-builds (tools.json).

operational_maturity.evidence: Founded 2011 with the category's longest enterprise track record and status transparency (tools.json).
